notes.title: Play test has ended!
notes.notes:
Hey charcoals!

The Flame Keeper closed play test has now come to a close. We want to thank everyone who played our fiery little roguelite, and especially those of you who took the time to fill out our survey. Your contribution is invaluable and will allow to us address your feedback as we move into early access soon!

If you haven't already, let us know what you thought of your playtime in our open survey here: 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFWL5f0kqjd6v_BOTJc8V0bYB1LyK5UCZEaOmuVBgwEjgJJQ/viewform

Stay tuned for an incoming release date announcement, and remember to join our Discord below to catch up on Flame Keeper's development and talk to some of us on the team! We'd love to hear everything you have to say!

[url=https://discord.gg/cYVNyfdwtq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/7beb8fe4b8ef486efc569655b546e1d57c621a7d.gif[/img][/url]

All the best,
[i]Kautki Cave and Untold Tales[/i]

notes.title: Play Test is live. Jump on in!
notes.notes:
Hey charcoals!

Congratulations on joining us as a player in our closed beta test. We hope you enjoy your stay in the lands of Orbis. Remember, your currency is your life! So spend it wisely, stay on your toes, and keep the flame alive! We're excited to share this first taste with you all, and we're looking for your feedback!

This is the link to our survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfFWL5f0kqjd6v_BOTJc8V0bYB1LyK5UCZEaOmuVBgwEjgJJQ/viewform

Remember to join our Discord below to catch up on Flame Keeper's development and talk to some of us on the team! We'd love to chat.

[url=https://discord.gg/cYVNyfdwtq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/7beb8fe4b8ef486efc569655b546e1d57c621a7d.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Welcome to the Flame Keeper Closed Beta, launching on January 30!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

Welcome to the Flame Keeper Beta Play Test. We'll be going live next week on January 30. As early players, you will experience the most up-to-date version of Flame Keeper with all the sweet content, levels and mechanics currently implemented into the game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XBxu7V-iBKo&ab_channel=UntoldTales

In the meantime, don't forget to join our Discord below to become part of the conversation and stay tuned! We've got plenty more to share in the weeks and months ahead!

[url=https://discord.gg/cYVNyfdwtq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40779345/7beb8fe4b8ef486efc569655b546e1d57c621a7d.gif[/img][/url]

We'll provide further information and what to look for and how to leave some awesome feedback for us in the coming days. Thank you!

All the best,
Kautki Cave and Untold Tales
